goal: Prevent library users from wrongly assuming they can create isolated loggers by enforcing one connection
agreement: Concept approval because single connections are simpler and pragmatic (sedited)
Unaddressed objection: prematurely restricts kernel logging API and is hard to reverse (ryanofsky)

categories.name: kernel
why: P3 because it aligns the C API with the singleton logger and prevents misleading caller assumptions
It provides a minor API cleanup without unblocking larger validation extraction work
